resources.string: Shown while the touch lock is armed or active.
Locking in %1$d s. Switch back to the call now.
Child Lock could not start. Nothing is locked.
Set a PIN first, or choose a different unlock gesture
Child Lock is active. Touch is disabled.

Optional hardening for Child Lock. Only active while the touch lock is on: it swallows the back and volume buttons, closes the notification shade if it is pulled down, and returns to the video call if the child leaves it. It never reads or stores what is on screen.
Blocks buttons and the shade while Child Lock is on
Unlocked. Open the video call, come back here and tap Arm.
Locked. Touch is disabled everywhere except the unlock gesture.
You will be returned to the previous app. Touch locks %1$d seconds later. You can also tap the Child Lock tile in Quick Settings.
Required. This is how touches are blocked without covering the screen.
Shows a quiet “locked” notice so you always know the state.
Optional. Blocks back and volume buttons, closes the notification shade, and returns to the call if the child leaves it.
Android 13+ hides the switch for sideloaded apps. In App info open the ⋮ menu and choose “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
Hold one finger in each of two opposite corners at the same time. Any extra finger restarts the timer.
Hold the small badge until a keypad appears, then enter your PIN. Three wrong PINs hide the keypad for 30 seconds.
Hold both volume buttons together. Needs the accessibility guard. The corner hold stays available as a fallback.
Stops the screen timing out during the call.
The three options below need the accessibility guard enabled above.
Volume still works for the volume chord gesture.
Closes it the moment it is pulled down.
If the child reaches the home screen, the call app is brought straight back.
Hold one finger in each chosen corner for the hold duration. A ring fills around the badge; a buzz confirms the unlock.
Hold the badge for the hold duration until the keypad appears, then enter your PIN.
Hold volume up and volume down together for the hold duration. The corner hold also works.
The lock is never saved. If anything goes wrong, restart the phone and it starts unlocked. The power button always works.
